name: OSK
recent: OSK Holdings Berhad 近期公布 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收与净利均较上季及去年同期增长。公司同时推进品牌重塑，将三大业务分部统一以 CID 品牌呈现，并启动墨尔本 AURA 大楼建设工程。执行主席 Tan Sri Ong Leong Huat 与集团董事经理 Ong Ju Yan 在 10 月多次申报增持公司股份。
notable: 公司公布 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度净利 RM143.41 million，营收 RM563.07 million。
OSK 推出品牌重塑，三大业务分部将以 CID 品牌呈现。
OSK Property 位于墨尔本的 AURA 大楼（价值 A$800 million）开始施工。
risks: 执行主席 Tan Sri Ong Leong Huat 与集团董事经理 Ong Ju Yan 在 10 月多次申报增持股份，涉及直接与间接权益。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM563.07 million，较上季增长 29.5%，较去年同期增长 10.3%；净利为 RM143.41 million，较上季增长 3.9%，较去年同期增长 1.0%；净利率为 25.5%，低于上季的 31.8%。

recent_en: OSK Holdings Berhad recently reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with both revenue and net profit rising quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year. The company is also progressing a brand refresh, unifying three divisions under the CID brand, and has commenced construction of the AURA tower in Melbourne. Executive Chairman Tan Sri Ong Leong Huat and Group Managing Director Ong Ju Yan filed multiple notices of share acquisitions in October.
notable_en: The company reported a net profit of RM143.41 million on revenue of RM563.07 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
OSK unveiled a brand refresh, with three business divisions to be represented under the CID brand.
Construction has begun on OSK Property's A$800 million AURA tower in Melbourne.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Tan Sri Ong Leong Huat and Group Managing Director Ong Ju Yan filed multiple notices of share acquisitions in October, covering both direct and indirect interests.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM563.07 million, up 29.5% quarter-on-quarter and 10.3% year-on-year; net profit was RM143.41 million, up 3.9% quarter-on-quarter and 1.0% year-on-year; net margin was 25.5%, lower than 31.8% in the previous quarter.
